title: Auth and tenancy
text: The SaaS backend needs tenants, users, memberships, roles, API keys, service accounts, audit events, and private/public primitive visibility controls.

title: Billing and metering
text: Meter search queries, vector reads, embedding jobs, source scans, blueprint generation, eval runs, media generation, asset storage, LLM polishing tokens, and human-review minutes.

title: Hybrid primitive search
text: Search should combine keyword retrieval, vector retrieval, graph expansion, facets, ratings, freshness, verified-source trust, and LLM-polished explanations.

title: LLM polishing layer
text: Use a small cheap model such as a Gemma-class model to rewrite queries, group similar results, explain ranked matches, summarize tradeoffs, and detect missing pipeline components without treating it as the source of truth.

title: Container worker topology
text: Split web, API, search, ranker, LLM polisher, ingest, embedding, eval, blueprint, pricing, media, safety, and billing workers so expensive jobs scale separately from cheap search and UI requests.

title: Platform cost controls
text: Use CPU-first workers, cache embeddings and pricing snapshots, batch embedding jobs, isolate GPU media workers, support BYO provider keys, and run cost simulation before expensive jobs.
